question: Which office may mark a registration completed, issue a certificate or certification number, verify a certification and revoke it, and what evidence of completion must exist first?
decision: Only the org's designated education officer (default: officers) may mark completion, issue or revoke a certificate, and only after an attendance or assessment record exists. Members and stewards can never write completed, passed, certificate or verified fields; verified defaults to false.
